raw_reviews.author: User001
raw_reviews.title: App keeps crashing
raw_reviews.content: Every time I open the app it crashes within 5 seconds. I've tried reinstalling multiple times but nothing works. This bug is making the app completely broken and unusable. Please fix the crash issue immediately!

raw_reviews.author: User002
raw_reviews.title: Love connecting with friends
raw_reviews.content: I absolutely love this app! It's amazing how easy it is to stay connected with friends and family all over the world. The interface is perfect and easy to use. Great job team!

raw_reviews.title: It's ok but could be better
raw_reviews.content: The app is ok, not bad overall. It does what it's supposed to do but feels a bit normal compared to before. The new layout is average, nothing special. Performance is acceptable.

raw_reviews.title: Login problems again
raw_reviews.content: Having serious login issues since the last update. Keeps saying wrong password even though I know it's correct. I had to reset my password three times already. The login screen freezes sometimes too.

raw_reviews.title: Great app overall
raw_reviews.content: Great application for sharing moments with friends. I especially love the new photo editing features. Very easy to use and intuitive design. Only minor issues here and there.

raw_reviews.author: User006
raw_reviews.title: Too many ads
raw_reviews.content: Ads ads and more ads! I see an ad every 30 seconds when scrolling. It's so frustrating and makes the app slow. I can't even read posts properly anymore because ads keep popping up. This is getting ridiculous!

raw_reviews.author: User007
raw_reviews.title: Perfect for staying in touch
raw_reviews.content: Perfect social media app! I love how easy it is to share updates with my loved ones. The groups feature is amazing for organizing events. Connect friends from anywhere with just a few taps.

raw_reviews.author: User008
raw_reviews.title: Battery drain problem
raw_reviews.content: Huge battery drain issue with this version. My phone dies within 3 hours even when I'm just browsing. I checked and Facebook is using 70% of my battery in the background. Please fix the battery drain!

raw_reviews.author: User009
raw_reviews.title: Average experience
raw_reviews.content: It's a normal social app, average in most aspects. Some features are good, some need improvement. The video quality is not bad but could be better. Overall experience is just so-so.

raw_reviews.author: User010
raw_reviews.title: Forced update is annoying
raw_reviews.content: The forced update message keeps appearing every time I open the app! I don't want to update because the new versions are always slow and broken. Stop forcing updates on users, give us a choice!

raw_reviews.author: User011
raw_reviews.title: Love the marketplace
raw_reviews.content: I really love the marketplace feature! It's great for finding local deals. Easy to use interface makes selling and buying items simple. Great addition to the platform.

raw_reviews.author: User012
raw_reviews.title: Videos freeze constantly
raw_reviews.content: Videos freeze all the time when I try to watch them. I have to close and reopen the app every time. Sometimes the whole app freezes and I can't do anything. The slow loading is unbearable.

raw_reviews.author: User013
raw_reviews.title: Amazing community features
raw_reviews.content: Amazing app with wonderful community features! The groups help me connect with people who share my interests. It's easy to use and the layout looks perfect. Love this app more every day!

raw_reviews.author: User014
raw_reviews.title: Bug with notifications
raw_reviews.content: Notifications bug is driving me crazy! I get the same notification 10 times and then it won't go away even after I check it. The badge count never resets. This bug has been here for months.

raw_reviews.author: User015
raw_reviews.title: Not bad, needs improvements
raw_reviews.content: The app is not bad honestly. It works for basic social networking. Some features are quite good but the performance is just normal. I wish it was faster at loading images sometimes.

raw_reviews.author: User016
raw_reviews.title: Crash on profile page
raw_reviews.content: Serious crash issue: every time I click on someone's profile the app crashes immediately. Tried clearing cache, restarting phone, nothing fixes it. The app is broken for profile browsing.

raw_reviews.author: User017
raw_reviews.title: Easy to use social app
raw_reviews.content: This is the most easy to use social media app I've tried. Everything is where you expect it to be. Great for sharing photos and connecting with old friends. Highly recommend it!

raw_reviews.author: User018
raw_reviews.title: Slow app performance
raw_reviews.content: The app is so slow now! It takes 10 seconds just to open my feed. Scrolling is laggy and everything feels broken. I have a new phone so it's definitely not my device. Please optimize performance.

raw_reviews.author: User019
raw_reviews.title: Great memories feature
raw_reviews.content: The memories feature is great! I love seeing posts from previous years. It's amazing how this app helps me preserve special moments. Very easy to use and share memories with family.

raw_reviews.author: User020
raw_reviews.title: Just ok social platform
raw_reviews.content: It's an ok platform for social networking. Nothing extraordinary but gets the job done. Interface is normal and average. I use it daily but wouldn't say I'm a huge fan.

raw_reviews.author: User021
raw_reviews.title: Can't login at all
raw_reviews.content: Major login problem - I cannot login to my account at all! Two factor authentication is broken, the code never arrives. Contacted support 5 times with no response. This is completely unacceptable!

raw_reviews.author: User022
raw_reviews.title: Love the events feature
raw_reviews.content: I absolutely love the events planning feature! It makes organizing parties so easy and perfect. Connecting with friends to RSVP is amazing and intuitive. Great work developers!

raw_reviews.author: User023
raw_reviews.title: Ads interrupt every post
raw_reviews.content: Ads are everywhere now! I can't read 2 posts without an ad interrupting. The ads are also getting longer and louder. Too many sponsored posts make the experience broken and slow.

raw_reviews.author: User024
raw_reviews.title: Pretty good overall
raw_reviews.content: Pretty good social media application. The features are great and it's easy to navigate. I enjoy connecting with friends and family through it. Only minor complaints about some small bugs.

raw_reviews.author: User025
raw_reviews.title: Average user experience
raw_reviews.content: Average experience overall. The app is not bad but also not amazing. Some days it works fine, other days it feels slow and buggy. Normal performance for a big social app I guess.

raw_reviews.author: User026
raw_reviews.title: Battery drains overnight
raw_reviews.content: My battery drains from 100% to 20% overnight just from this app running in the background. I disabled all background refresh but still same battery drain problem. This is really broken behavior.

raw_reviews.author: User027
raw_reviews.title: Perfect for my business
raw_reviews.content: Perfect platform for growing my small business! The pages feature is amazing and easy to use. I love connecting with customers and sharing updates. Great for marketing and reaching new people.

raw_reviews.author: User028
raw_reviews.title: Freeze on startup
raw_reviews.content: The app freeze on startup every single time now. I see the logo then it freezes completely. I have to force close and try again 3-4 times. This is making the app broken and impossible to use quickly.

raw_reviews.author: User029
raw_reviews.title: Great sharing experience
raw_reviews.content: Great experience sharing content with my network! The photo albums are well organized and it's easy to tag friends. Love the new reactions feature too. Keep up the great work!

raw_reviews.author: User030
raw_reviews.title: It's normal, nothing special
raw_reviews.content: The app is normal honestly. It works when it needs to. I have nothing great to say but also nothing terrible. Average design, average features, just your typical social media platform.

raw_reviews.author: User031
raw_reviews.title: Crash when posting photos
raw_reviews.content: The app crashes every single time I try to post photos! I select the photos, add a caption, hit post and boom it crashes. Lost several posts because of this bug. The app is completely broken for posting!

raw_reviews.author: User032
raw_reviews.title: Amazing way to stay connected
raw_reviews.content: This app is amazing for staying connected with my large family across different countries! Video calls are crystal clear, messaging is perfect. It's easy to use even for my elderly parents. Love it!

raw_reviews.author: User033
raw_reviews.title: Login loop bug
raw_reviews.content: Stuck in a login loop! I enter my credentials correctly, it loads then kicks me back to login screen again. This bug has been reported for weeks. Tried everything, only using mobile site works now.

raw_reviews.author: User034
raw_reviews.title: Good app with minor issues
raw_reviews.content: Good social networking app overall. The interface is great and most features work perfectly. Minor issues with notifications sometimes. The groups and pages features are excellent for community building.

raw_reviews.author: User035
raw_reviews.title: Decent enough app
raw_reviews.content: Decent enough social platform. Not bad for what it does. The layout is a bit cluttered but functional. Performance is average these days, could definitely be faster. I keep using it out of habit.

raw_reviews.author: User036
raw_reviews.title: Forced update ruined everything
raw_reviews.content: That forced update last week completely ruined the app for me! Before the forced update everything was fine, now it's slow, full of ads, and crashes constantly. Why would you force a broken update on all users?

raw_reviews.author: User037
raw_reviews.title: Love everything about it
raw_reviews.content: I love everything about this application! From messaging to sharing photos to watching videos - everything is perfect and easy to use. Great job continuously improving the experience for all users.

raw_reviews.author: User038
raw_reviews.title: Slow loading feed
raw_reviews.content: The loading of my news feed is extremely slow! It spins for 15 seconds before showing anything. Images are slow to load and videos keep buffering. This used to be fast, what happened?

raw_reviews.author: User039
raw_reviews.title: Enjoy using it daily
raw_reviews.content: I enjoy using this app daily to catch up with what my friends are doing. The stories feature is great and easy to use. Connecting with people has never been simpler. Recommended!

raw_reviews.author: User040
raw_reviews.title: Just about average
raw_reviews.content: The app is just about average at this point. It's ok for scrolling but I wish there were fewer ads. Not bad but not as great as it used to be. Normal, run-of-the-mill social media.

raw_reviews.author: User041
raw_reviews.title: Bug in messenger integration
raw_reviews.content: The messenger integration is completely broken! When I click on messages the app crashes right away. Can't send or receive any messages because of this bug. Tried reinstalling 5 times with no fix.

raw_reviews.author: User042
raw_reviews.title: Wonderful community feel
raw_reviews.content: There's a wonderful community feel to this platform! It's amazing how well it connects people with similar interests. Easy to use interface makes navigating groups and pages a breeze. Great app!

raw_reviews.author: User043
raw_reviews.title: Ads are out of control
raw_reviews.content: The ads are completely out of control now! I see ads between stories, ads in comments, ads in groups. Everywhere I look there's an ad. The content feed is 80% ads, 20% actual posts. Too much!

raw_reviews.author: User044
raw_reviews.title: Great for photos
raw_reviews.content: Great platform for sharing photo albums with family and friends! The quality preservation is perfect. I love the album organization features. Very easy to use and reliable for storing memories.

raw_reviews.author: User045
raw_reviews.title: OK social networking option
raw_reviews.content: It's an OK social networking option. Not the best, not the worst. The features are normal and average compared to competitors. I use it mainly because my friends are here. It works.

raw_reviews.author: User046
raw_reviews.title: Battery drain is extreme
raw_reviews.content: The battery drain is absolutely extreme on this version! I lose 1% battery every minute the app is open. Phone gets burning hot too. This broken battery issue needs to be the top priority fix.

raw_reviews.author: User047
raw_reviews.title: Easy to learn and use
raw_reviews.content: Even my 80-year-old grandma finds this app easy to use! That says a lot about the design. She loves connecting with her grandkids through photos and videos. Great job making it accessible for everyone.

raw_reviews.author: User048
raw_reviews.title: UI freeze during scroll
raw_reviews.content: Constant UI freeze while scrolling through my feed! The app becomes completely unresponsive for 10-15 seconds then suddenly catches up. It's really frustrating and broken feeling. Needs urgent optimization.

raw_reviews.author: User049
raw_reviews.title: Solid social media choice
raw_reviews.content: A solid choice for social media overall. Great feature set, good privacy options, and excellent ways to connect friends and family. The occasional small bug but nothing that ruins the experience.

raw_reviews.author: User050
raw_reviews.title: Pretty normal experience
raw_reviews.content: My experience has been pretty normal honestly. Not great, not terrible. The app does what it's supposed to do without too many issues. Average layout, average speed, just a standard social app.

cleaned_reviews.content: The app is just about average at this point. It's ok for scrolling but I wish there were fewer ads. Not bad but not as great as it used to be. Normal, run-of-the-mill social media.

cleaned_reviews.author: User041
cleaned_reviews.title: Bug in messenger integration
cleaned_reviews.content: The messenger integration is completely broken! When I click on messages the app crashes right away. Can't send or receive any messages because of this bug. Tried reinstalling 5 times with no fix.

cleaned_reviews.author: User042
cleaned_reviews.title: Wonderful community feel
cleaned_reviews.content: There's a wonderful community feel to this platform! It's amazing how well it connects people with similar interests. Easy to use interface makes navigating groups and pages a breeze. Great app!

cleaned_reviews.author: User043
cleaned_reviews.title: Ads are out of control
cleaned_reviews.content: The ads are completely out of control now! I see ads between stories, ads in comments, ads in groups. Everywhere I look there's an ad. The content feed is 80% ads, 20% actual posts. Too much!

cleaned_reviews.author: User044
cleaned_reviews.title: Great for photos
cleaned_reviews.content: Great platform for sharing photo albums with family and friends! The quality preservation is perfect. I love the album organization features. Very easy to use and reliable for storing memories.

cleaned_reviews.author: User045
cleaned_reviews.title: OK social networking option
cleaned_reviews.content: It's an OK social networking option. Not the best, not the worst. The features are normal and average compared to competitors. I use it mainly because my friends are here. It works.

cleaned_reviews.author: User046
cleaned_reviews.title: Battery drain is extreme
cleaned_reviews.content: The battery drain is absolutely extreme on this version! I lose 1% battery every minute the app is open. Phone gets burning hot too. This broken battery issue needs to be the top priority fix.

cleaned_reviews.author: User047
cleaned_reviews.title: Easy to learn and use
cleaned_reviews.content: Even my 80-year-old grandma finds this app easy to use! That says a lot about the design. She loves connecting with her grandkids through photos and videos. Great job making it accessible for everyone.

cleaned_reviews.author: User048
cleaned_reviews.title: UI freeze during scroll
cleaned_reviews.content: Constant UI freeze while scrolling through my feed! The app becomes completely unresponsive for 10-15 seconds then suddenly catches up. It's really frustrating and broken feeling. Needs urgent optimization.

cleaned_reviews.author: User049
cleaned_reviews.title: Solid social media choice
cleaned_reviews.content: A solid choice for social media overall. Great feature set, good privacy options, and excellent ways to connect friends and family. The occasional small bug but nothing that ruins the experience.

cleaned_reviews.author: User050
cleaned_reviews.title: Pretty normal experience
cleaned_reviews.content: My experience has been pretty normal honestly. Not great, not terrible. The app does what it's supposed to do without too many issues. Average layout, average speed, just a standard social app.
